definition{
  name: natMember,
  parameters: [value : Nat, values : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((value =? head) || (natMember value rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: allMembers,
  parameters: [wanted : (List Nat), values : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match wanted
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((natMember head values) && (allMembers rest values))),
  recursive_argument: wanted
}

definition{
  name: sameNats,
  parameters: [left : (List Nat), right : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match left
    | List.nil => (match right | List.nil => true | List.cons other more => false)
    | List.cons head rest => (match right
      | List.nil => false
      | List.cons other more => ((head =? other) && (sameNats rest more)))),
  recursive_argument: left
}

definition{
  name: stringMember,
  parameters: [value : String, values : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((prim equal value head : Bool) || (stringMember value rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: allStringMembers,
  parameters: [wanted : (List String), values : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match wanted
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((stringMember head values) && (allStringMembers rest values))),
  recursive_argument: wanted
}

definition{
  name: nonEmpty,
  parameters: [text : String],

}

definition{
  name: risksCovered,
  parameters: [risks : (List Foundation.Sec::Risk)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match risks
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => (((natMember (project head index) (controlRisks (controlRecords))) || (natMember (project head index) (acceptedRisks (acceptances)))) && (risksCovered rest))),
  recursive_argument: risks
}

definition{
  name: threatCovered,
  parameters: [threat : Nat, risks : (List Foundation.Sec::Risk)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match risks
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((((project head threatIndex) =? threat) && ((natMember (project head index) (controlRisks (controlRecords))) || (natMember (project head index) (acceptedRisks (acceptances))))) || (threatCovered threat rest))),
  recursive_argument: risks
}

definition{

    | List.cons head rest => ((threatCovered (project head index) (riskRecords)) && (threatsCovered rest))),
  recursive_argument: threats
}

definition{

  parameters: [binding : ControlBinding, declared : (List String)],

  body: (match (project binding status)
    | ControlStatus.Declared => (stringMember (project binding systemControl) declared)
    | ControlStatus.Pending reason => ((if (stringMember (project binding systemControl) declared) then false else true) && (nonEmpty reason)))
}
